answer: Proposal: weight accounts by a public endorsement graph. Each account endorses ≤ m others, cap on-ledger; influence spreads from an operator-verified seed like a ripple, but flow across a cut is capped by that cut's edge count — any sybil cluster drains only through the few honest edges it bought. Proven fraud in an endorsed child slashes the guarantor's stake, so edges are priced; total take ≤ edges × per-edge cap; profit needs cap > rent — linear in edges, not identities. The honest core is a glacier; the seed is the stated root — no ivory tower. Seams: edge markets, seed capture.
